subject: Intro + exec demo — CTO attendance and backup
thread_text:
--- Message 1 of 4 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@noventis.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + exec demo — request for CTO presence

Hi Marta,

Great to connect earlier this week. Noventis's use case around secure on-prem inference sounds like a perfect fit for what Redwood Dedicated + Private can address. We recommended a short exec-level demo to show the end-to-end flow (model serving, latency SLAs, and audit logs) for your leadership team — ideally with your CTO and VP of AI in attendance.

Would the following 45-minute windows work for an exec-focused session? We can tailor the run-of-show to focus on the topics you care about (data residency, audit trails, and failover routing):
- Tue Apr 20, 11:00–11:45 CEST
- Wed Apr 21, 09:00–09:45 CEST

I've attached a brief runbook and an .ics with both provisional slots. If neither works, tell us two windows and we'll do our best to move team calendars.

Priyom, Sofia — can you be on the call as technical leads? If the CTO needs a substitute, can we confirm a senior technical sponsor who can cover the architecture section?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
"Briefing-runbook.pdf" attached

--- Message 2 of 4 ---
From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@noventis.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Intro + exec demo — request for CTO presence

Hi Ben,

Thanks — those look sensible. Our CTO, Henrik Larsen, is travelling Apr 20 but Henrik can make the 09:00 Wed slot if we keep to 45 minutes. If not, he asked whether a late-afternoon slot on Thu Apr 22 (16:00–16:45 CEST) might be possible — he prefers a single focused demo rather than two separate sessions.

Can Sofia and Priyom run the architecture segment and leave a short Q&A for Henrik? Also, can you share a single-slide TL;DR for the exec audience and the run-of-show?

Regards,
Marta

Marta Silva
Head of Enterprise AI Programs
Noventis
"proposed-slots.ics" attached

--- Message 3 of 4 ---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + exec demo — request for CTO presence

Ben / Sofia,

I can own the architecture walk and demo the Private deployment flow. Sofia — can you take the SLAs & observability short deck and be ready to hit the TL;DR slide at the top (2–3 bullets for execs)?

If Henrik ends up unavailable, proposed fallback: ask Noventis to have the VP of AI (Marta + one other senior) join and we keep the same agenda. We should also have a short recorded demo snippet (3–4 minutes) ready to play if we need to accommodate a CTO with time constraints.

I'll prep the recording and a 1-slide TL;DR. Ben — can you send the final invite once Marta confirms the exact slot? I'll upload the recording link to the shared notes.

Cheers,
Priyom

--- Message 4 of 4 ---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@noventis.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + exec demo — request for CTO presence

Hi Marta — happy to confirm Wed Apr 21, 09:00–09:45 CEST.

Run-of-show (45 min):
- 09:00–09:03 — Welcome + objectives (Ben)
- 09:03–09:12 — TL;DR for execs (Sofia)
- 09:12–09:30 — Architecture & live demo (Priyom)
- 09:30–09:40 — Failover, audit logs, and quantization/cost levers (Sofia)
- 09:40–09:45 — Q&A and next steps (All)

I'll send the calendar invite with the runbook attached and a short recording in case Henrik needs a quick catch-up. If Henrik later confirms Thu 22 at 16:00, we can mark that as an optional backup.

See you Wednesday,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
